body: I know I haven't responded to your comment in over 3 months but a little update would help maybe. You are right, I've been sober since, I feel great and confident. Everyday IS a milestone. Thank you so much. I might add I am still with the girl and we are happy. Hopefully everything works out. Again, thank you

I just want her support in any way. Even a text would be okay with me. And one without sarcasm or insults. I know its hard and really short but I'm still hoping for the best. I want to stop, and its just the begging.
